item_description:
The cover page has several signatures: cu 48, with zi written to the right of cu. Another signature seems to have been crossed out: na 6? li khang.
Below the title an inscription could have been rubbed off.
Script: dbu med ('bru tsha)
Lines per folio: 9.
In the left margin on fol. 1a: ka (volume letter?)
Proofread once (lan cig zhus)
